items.exampleEn: My sister hopes to study biotechnology in college.
items.exampleZh: 我的姊妹希望在大學念生物科技。

items.exampleEn: Hot springs often smell of sulfur, like rotten eggs.
items.exampleZh: 溫泉常有硫磺味，聞起來像臭雞蛋。

items.exampleEn: This soft cloth removes microscopic dust from your glasses.
items.exampleZh: 這塊軟布能擦掉眼鏡上極微小的灰塵。
items.glossZh: 極小的；顯微鏡下才看得到的

items.exampleEn: Scientifically speaking, a tomato is a fruit, not a vegetable.
items.exampleZh: 從科學角度來說，番茄是水果，不是蔬菜。

items.exampleEn: Forestry is an important industry in the mountain villages of this area.
items.exampleZh: 林業是這一帶山村的重要產業。

items.exampleEn: The factory recycles the solvent it uses, so very little is wasted.
items.exampleZh: 那家工廠會回收用過的溶劑，所以幾乎沒有浪費。

items.exampleEn: Students must sign up for at least two electives before the end of May.
items.exampleZh: 學生必須在五月底前登記至少兩門選修課。

items.exampleEn: Ammonia has a very strong smell that makes your eyes water.
items.exampleZh: 氨的氣味非常強烈，會讓人眼睛流淚。

items.sentenceEn: Some germs are microscopic and live inside our bodies.
items.sentenceZh: 有些病菌極小，生活在我們體內。

items.audioEn: You can choose one elective this term: art, drama or computer coding.
items.audioZh: 這學期你可以選一門選修課：美術、戲劇或程式設計。
items.questionZh: 這學期可以選幾門選修課？

items.sentenceEn: My uncle studied forestry and now works in a national park.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔念林業，現在在國家公園工作。

items.sentenceEn: Some cleaning products for windows contain ammonia.
items.sentenceZh: 有些窗戶清潔劑含有氨。

items.stemEn: Is this new cleaning method ____ proven, or is it just advertising?
items.stemZh: 這種新的清潔方法有科學根據嗎？還是純粹是廣告？

items.stemEn: This strong ____ can remove oil paint from brushes.
items.stemZh: 這種強力溶劑能把油畫顏料從畫筆上洗掉。

items.passageEn: Our school's science week this year focused on the future. A speaker from a biotechnology company explained how scientists change microscopic parts of plants to help them survive dry weather. In the lab, we tested which liquids work as a solvent for salt and sugar. Our teacher also showed us a rock covered with yellow sulfur, and we learned that ammonia is used to help crops grow. A forestry expert talked about protecting forests while still using wood. Finally, students shared which elective they would choose next year. I want to study plants scientifically, and one day I hope to win a trophy at the science fair.
items.passageZh: 我們學校今年的科學週以未來為主題。一位生物科技公司的講者說明科學家如何改變植物極微小的部分，幫助它們熬過乾旱。在實驗室裡，我們測試哪些液體可以當鹽和糖的溶劑。老師也給我們看一塊布滿黃色硫磺的石頭，我們還學到氨被用來幫助作物生長。一位林業專家談到如何在利用木材的同時保護森林。最後，同學們分享明年要選哪一門選修課。我想用科學的方法研究植物，希望有一天能在科展上贏得獎盃。

questions.questionZh: 生物科技公司的講者談到什麼？
options: 如何用氨來幫助各種作物生長
如何改變植物以熬過乾旱
如何保護森林又能使用木材
如何挑選明年的選修課
到生物科技公司去實習
成為一位真正的林業專家

items.promptZh: 這個說法還沒有經過科學證實。
referenceEn: This claim has not been scientifically proven yet.
This idea hasn't been proven scientifically.
rubricZh: scientifically 是副詞，修飾 proven（例如 scientifically proven）
時態合理即可（例如 has not been proven、is not proven）

items.promptZh: 我弟弟這學期修了一門攝影選修課。
referenceEn: My younger brother is taking a photography elective this term.
This term, my little brother is taking an elective in photography.
rubricZh: elective 指選修課（例如 a photography elective、an elective in photography 等）
時態可用現在進行式、過去式或現在完成式（例如 is taking、took、has chosen 等）
「弟弟」可寫，例如 younger brother、little brother、brother 等
